model_info.type: Extended Biophysical Bioheat (4 parameters, raw causal finite diff)
Extended Biophysical Bioheat (4 parameters, 60s causal filtered derivative)

extended_bioheat_raw.interpretation: c is fitted to 4.44s rather than nominal tau=180s due to high-frequency sensor noise amplification (NETD 0.05C, ADC 0.02C) in raw finite differentiation.

extended_bioheat_filtered.interpretation: Causal 60s filtering reduces noise amplification, increasing fitted c to 10.83s and reducing test MAE to 0.3010C.

direct_mlp.interpretation: Direct MLP leverages multi-scale temporal features (60s and 180s rolling means) to implicitly denoise and track transients, achieving 93.3% pass rate.

residual_pimlp.interpretation: Residual PIMLP achieves lowest overall pooled MAE (0.2188C) and successfully resolves severe transient error in Case 5 (MAE 0.3243C vs 0.5965C baseline).
